business_summary: PCI Technology Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides software and information technology services in China. It offers enterprise digital transformation and upgrade, smart city cluster integrated transportation, smart city rail transit communication, and smart city traffic management solutions. Additionally, it offers multispectral pantograph-catenary inspection system; a rail magnetic flux leakage inspection system for detecting surface and near-surface defects; a rail break monitoring system; and a portable rail temperature; and stress measurement device. The company also engages in the intelligent product integration business; video surveillance subsystem solutions; IT operations, maintenance, and architecture outsourcing services; network maintenance; sale of computer spare parts and peripherals; equity investment; trust and venture capital management; and core software development. In addition, it is involved in network technology research and development; information and electronic technology consulting services; sale of software and hardware; business management consulting; import and export of goods and technology; data processing and storage support services; and artificial intelligence research and development. The company was formerly known as PCI-Suntek Technology Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to PCI Technology Group Co., Ltd. in April 2021. PCI Technology Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
